Wait: in S1960, `lgpStrip D` is definitionally `reducedQPilotAnchor D`. Let's look at S1951KummerEvaluationSquareActual to see `lgpStrip`, `envStrip` etc. and whether S1967/S1963 built them from actual data. Also S1963SignActionAssemblyActual exists (an actual file). Let me check what strips S1951 uses.
